structure Shape where
  dims : List Nat
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

def Shape.ndim (s : Shape) : Nat := s.dims.length

def Shape.totalSize (s : Shape) : Nat := s.dims.foldl (· * ·) 1

def Shape.isValid (s : Shape) : Prop := s.dims.length > 0 ∧ s.totalSize > 0

structure Tensor where
  data : Array ℝ
  shape : Shape
  deriving Repr

def Tensor.size (t : Tensor) : Nat := t.data.size

def Tensor.ndim (t : Tensor) : Nat := t.shape.ndim

def Tensor.isValid (t : Tensor) : Prop :=
  t.shape.isValid ∧ t.data.size = t.shape.totalSize

def Tensor.isZero (t : Tensor) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin t.data.size, t.data[i] = 0

def Tensor.hasShape (t : Tensor) (s : Shape) : Prop :=
  t.shape = s

def Tensor.dataSizeMatchesShape (t : Tensor) : Prop :=
  t.data.size = t.shape.totalSize

structure RSFLayerConfig where
  clip_min : ℝ := -5
  clip_max : ℝ := 5
  seed_offset : Nat := 0
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

structure RSFLayer where
  s_weight : Tensor
  t_weight : Tensor
  s_bias : Tensor
  t_bias : Tensor
  s_weight_grad : Tensor
  t_weight_grad : Tensor
  s_bias_grad : Tensor
  t_bias_grad : Tensor
  dim : Nat
  clip_min : ℝ
  clip_max : ℝ
  initialized : Bool
  deriving Repr

structure RSF where
  layers : Array RSFLayer
  num_layers : Nat
  dim : Nat
  initialized : Bool
  deriving Repr

inductive RSFError where
  | InvalidDimension
  | InvalidLayerCount
  | NotInitialized
  | ShapeMismatch
  | InvalidEpsilon
  | UnsupportedVersion
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

def RSFLayerConfig.default : RSFLayerConfig :=
  { clip_min := -5, clip_max := 5, seed_offset := 0 }

def RSFLayerConfig.isValid (config : RSFLayerConfig) : Prop :=
  config.clip_min < config.clip_max

def Shape.isWeightShape (s : Shape) (dim : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.dims = [dim, dim]

def Shape.isBiasShape (s : Shape) (dim : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.dims = [1, dim]

def RSFLayer.isValid (layer : RSFLayer) : Prop :=
  layer.dim > 0 ∧
  layer.clip_min < layer.clip_max ∧
  layer.s_weight.isValid ∧
  layer.t_weight.isValid ∧
  layer.s_bias.isValid ∧
  layer.t_bias.isValid ∧
  layer.s_weight_grad.isValid ∧
  layer.t_weight_grad.isValid ∧
  layer.s_bias_grad.isValid ∧
  layer.t_bias_grad.isValid

def RSFLayer.isInitialized (layer : RSFLayer) : Prop :=
  layer.initialized = true ∧ layer.isValid

def RSF.isValid (rsf : RSF) : Prop :=
  rsf.dim > 0 ∧
  rsf.num_layers > 0 ∧
  rsf.layers.size = rsf.num_layers ∧
  ∀ i < rsf.layers.size, (rsf.layers[i]).isValid ∧ (rsf.layers[i]).dim = rsf.dim

def RSF.isInitialized (rsf : RSF) : Prop :=
  rsf.initialized = true ∧ rsf.isValid

def computeXavierStd (dim : Nat) : ℝ :=
  let fan_in := (dim : ℝ)
  let fan_out := (dim : ℝ)
  let fan_sum := fan_in + fan_out
  if fan_sum > 0 then Real.sqrt (2 / fan_sum) else 0

def createZeroTensor (shape : Shape) : Tensor :=
  { data := Array.mkArray shape.totalSize 0, shape := shape }

def createWeightShape (dim : Nat) : Shape :=
  { dims := [dim, dim] }

def createBiasShape (dim : Nat) : Shape :=
  { dims := [1, dim] }

def createRandomTensor (shape : Shape) (low high : ℝ) (seed : Nat) : Tensor :=
  let size := shape.totalSize
  let range := high - low
  let data := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin size =>
    let idx := i.val
    let pseudoRandom := ((seed + idx * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648 : ℝ)
    let normalized := pseudoRandom / 2147483648
    low + range * normalized
  { data := data, shape := shape }

def RSFLayer.create (dim : Nat) (config : RSFLayerConfig) : Except RSFError RSFLayer :=
  if dim = 0 then
    Except.error RSFError.InvalidDimension
  else
    let xavier_std := computeXavierStd dim
    let weight_shape := createWeightShape dim
    let bias_shape := createBiasShape dim
    let s_w := createRandomTensor weight_shape (-xavier_std) xavier_std (42 + config.seed_offset)
    let t_w := createRandomTensor weight_shape (-xavier_std) xavier_std (43 + config.seed_offset)
    let s_b := createZeroTensor bias_shape
    let t_b := createZeroTensor bias_shape
    let s_w_grad := createZeroTensor weight_shape
    let t_w_grad := createZeroTensor weight_shape
    let s_b_grad := createZeroTensor bias_shape
    let t_b_grad := createZeroTensor bias_shape
    Except.ok {
      s_weight := s_w
      t_weight := t_w
      s_bias := s_b
      t_bias := t_b
      s_weight_grad := s_w_grad
      t_weight_grad := t_w_grad
      s_bias_grad := s_b_grad
      t_bias_grad := t_b_grad
      dim := dim
      clip_min := config.clip_min
      clip_max := config.clip_max
      initialized := true
    }

def RSFLayer.init (dim : Nat) : Except RSFError RSFLayer :=
  RSFLayer.create dim RSFLayerConfig.default

def RSFLayer.initWithConfig (dim : Nat) (config : RSFLayerConfig) : Except RSFError RSFLayer :=
  RSFLayer.create dim config

def RSFLayer.deinit (layer : RSFLayer) : RSFLayer :=
  if layer.initialized then
    { layer with initialized := false }
  else
    layer

def Tensor.zeroOut (t : Tensor) : Tensor :=
  { t with data := Array.mkArray t.data.size 0 }

def RSFLayer.zeroGradients (layer : RSFLayer) : RSFLayer :=
  if layer.initialized then
    { layer with
      s_weight_grad := layer.s_weight_grad.zeroOut
      t_weight_grad := layer.t_weight_grad.zeroOut
      s_bias_grad := layer.s_bias_grad.zeroOut
      t_bias_grad := layer.t_bias_grad.zeroOut
    }
  else
    layer

def Tensor.transpose2D (t : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  match t.shape.dims with
  | [rows, cols] =>
    let newShape : Shape := { dims := [cols, rows] }
    let newData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin (cols * rows) =>
      let newRow := i.val / rows
      let newCol := i.val % rows
      let oldIdx := newCol * cols + newRow
      t.data[⟨oldIdx, by decide⟩]
    some { data := newData, shape := newShape }
  | _ => none

def Tensor.matmul (a b : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  match a.shape.dims, b.shape.dims with
  | [m, k1], [k2, n] =>
    if k1 = k2 then
      let resultShape : Shape := { dims := [m, n] }
      let resultData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin (m * n) =>
        let row := i.val / n
        let col := i.val % n
        let sum := (List.range k1).foldl (fun acc j =>
          let aIdx := row * k1 + j
          let bIdx := j * n + col
          let aVal := a.data[⟨aIdx, by decide⟩]
          let bVal := b.data[⟨bIdx, by decide⟩]
          acc + aVal * bVal) 0
      some { data := resultData, shape := resultShape }
    else
      none
  | _, _ => none

def Real.clip (x lo hi : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if x < lo then lo else if x > hi then hi else x

def Tensor.clipInPlace (t : Tensor) (lo hi : ℝ) : Tensor :=
  { t with data := t.data.map (fun x => Real.clip x lo hi) }

def Tensor.expInPlace (t : Tensor) : Tensor :=
  { t with data := t.data.map fun x => Real.exp x }

def Tensor.mulElementwise (a b : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  if a.data.size = b.data.size then
    some { a with data := Array.zipWith a.data b.data (· * ·) }
  else
    none

def Tensor.divElementwise (a b : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  if a.data.size = b.data.size then
    some { a with data := Array.zipWith a.data b.data (· / ·) }
  else
    none

def Tensor.addElementwise (a b : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  if a.data.size = b.data.size then
    some { a with data := Array.zipWith a.data b.data (· + ·) }
  else
    none

def Tensor.subElementwise (a b : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  if a.data.size = b.data.size then
    some { a with data := Array.zipWith a.data b.data (· - ·) }
  else
    none

def Tensor.addBias (t : Tensor) (bias : Tensor) (batchSize dim : Nat) : Tensor :=
  let newData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin t.data.size =>
    let b := i.val / dim
    let d := i.val % dim
    let tVal := t.data[i]
    let biasIdx : Fin bias.data.size := ⟨d, by
      have h : bias.data.size = dim := by
        unfold createBiasShape Shape.totalSize at bias
        cases bias.shape.dims
        rfl
        omega
      omega⟩
    let biasVal := bias.data[biasIdx]
    tVal + biasVal
  { t with data := newData }

def RSFLayer.forwardStep (layer : RSFLayer) (x1 x2 : Tensor) : Option (Tensor × Tensor) :=
  if ¬layer.initialized then none
  else
    match x1.shape.dims, x2.shape.dims with
    | [batchSize, dim1], [batchSize2, dim2] =>
      if dim1 = layer.dim ∧ dim2 = layer.dim ∧ batchSize = batchSize2 then
        match x2.transpose2D with
        | some x2_t =>
          match layer.s_weight.matmul x2_t with
          | some s_x2_t =>
            match s_x2_t.transpose2D with
            | some s_x2 =>
              let s_x2_biased := s_x2.addBias layer.s_bias batchSize layer.dim
              let s_x2_clipped := s_x2_biased.clipInPlace layer.clip_min layer.clip_max
              let s_x2_exp := s_x2_clipped.expInPlace
              match x1.mulElementwise s_x2_exp with
              | some y1 =>
                match y1.transpose2D with
                | some y1_t =>
                  match layer.t_weight.matmul y1_t with
                  | some t_y1_t =>
                    match t_y1_t.transpose2D with
                    | some t_y1 =>
                      let t_y1_biased := t_y1.addBias layer.t_bias batchSize layer.dim
                      match x2.addElementwise t_y1_biased with
                      | some y2 => some (y1, y2)
                      | none => none
                    | none => none
                  | none => none
                | none => none
              | none => none
            | none => none
          | none => none
        | none => none
      else none
    | _, _ => none

def RSFLayer.inverseStep (layer : RSFLayer) (y1 y2 : Tensor) : Option (Tensor × Tensor) :=
  if ¬layer.initialized then none
  else
    match y1.shape.dims, y2.shape.dims with
    | [batchSize, dim1], [batchSize2, dim2] =>
      if dim1 = layer.dim ∧ dim2 = layer.dim ∧ batchSize = batchSize2 then
        match y1.transpose2D with
        | some y1_t =>
          match layer.t_weight.matmul y1_t with
          | some t_y1_t =>
            match t_y1_t.transpose2D with
            | some t_y1 =>
              let t_y1_biased := t_y1.addBias layer.t_bias batchSize layer.dim
              match y2.subElementwise t_y1_biased with
              | some x2 =>
                match x2.transpose2D with
                | some x2_t =>
                  match layer.s_weight.matmul x2_t with
                  | some s_x2_t =>
                    match s_x2_t.transpose2D with
                    | some s_x2 =>
                      let s_x2_biased := s_x2.addBias layer.s_bias batchSize layer.dim
                      let s_x2_clipped := s_x2_biased.clipInPlace layer.clip_min layer.clip_max
                      let s_x2_exp := s_x2_clipped.expInPlace
                      match y1.divElementwise s_x2_exp with
                      | some x1 => some (x1, x2)
                      | none => none
                    | none => none
                  | none => none
                | none => none
              | none => none
            | none => none
          | none => none
        | none => none
      else none
    | _, _ => none

def RSFLayer.getParameters (layer : RSFLayer) : Array Tensor :=
  #[layer.s_weight, layer.t_weight, layer.s_bias, layer.t_bias]

def RSFLayer.getGradients (layer : RSFLayer) : Array Tensor :=
  #[layer.s_weight_grad, layer.t_weight_grad, layer.s_bias_grad, layer.t_bias_grad]

def RSF.create (dim : Nat) (num_layers : Nat) : Except RSFError RSF :=
  if dim = 0 then
    Except.error RSFError.InvalidDimension
  else if num_layers = 0 then
    Except.error RSFError.InvalidLayerCount
  else
    let layers := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin num_layers =>
      let config : RSFLayerConfig := { clip_min := -5, clip_max := 5, seed_offset := i.val * 100 }
      match RSFLayer.create dim config with
      | Except.ok layer => layer
      | Except.error _ => {
          s_weight := createZeroTensor (createWeightShape dim)
          t_weight := createZeroTensor (createWeightShape dim)
          s_bias := createZeroTensor (createBiasShape dim)
          t_bias := createZeroTensor (createBiasShape dim)
          s_weight_grad := createZeroTensor (createWeightShape dim)
          t_weight_grad := createZeroTensor (createWeightShape dim)
          s_bias_grad := createZeroTensor (createBiasShape dim)
          t_bias_grad := createZeroTensor (createBiasShape dim)
          dim := dim
          clip_min := -5
          clip_max := 5
          initialized := false
        }
    Except.ok {
      layers := layers
      num_layers := num_layers
      dim := dim
      initialized := true
    }

def RSF.init (dim : Nat) (num_layers : Nat) : Except RSFError RSF :=
  RSF.create dim num_layers

def RSF.deinit (rsf : RSF) : RSF :=
  if rsf.initialized then
    let newLayers := rsf.layers.map RSFLayer.deinit
    { rsf with layers := newLayers, initialized := false }
  else
    rsf

def RSF.zeroAllGradients (rsf : RSF) : RSF :=
  { rsf with layers := rsf.layers.map RSFLayer.zeroGradients }

def Tensor.copy (t : Tensor) : Tensor :=
  { data := t.data, shape := t.shape }

def Tensor.isClose (a b : Tensor) (rtol atol : ℝ) : Bool :=
  if a.data.size ≠ b.data.size then false
  else
    let pairs := Array.zip a.data b.data
    pairs.all fun (x, y) =>
      let diff := if x > y then x - y else y - x
      let threshold := atol + rtol * (if y > 0 then y else -y)
      diff ≤ threshold

def RSF.forwardPass (rsf : RSF) (x : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  if ¬rsf.initialized then none
  else
    match x.shape.dims with
    | [batchSize, totalDim] =>
      if totalDim ≠ 2 * rsf.dim then none
      else
        let dim := rsf.dim
        let x1Shape : Shape := { dims := [batchSize, dim] }
        let x2Shape : Shape := { dims := [batchSize, dim] }
        let x1Data := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin (batchSize * dim) =>
          let row := i.val / dim
          let col := i.val % dim
          let srcIdx := row * totalDim + col
          x.data[⟨srcIdx, by decide⟩]
        let x2Data := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin (batchSize * dim) =>
          let row := i.val / dim
          let col := i.val % dim
          let srcIdx := row * totalDim + col + dim
          x.data[⟨srcIdx, by decide⟩]
        let x1 := { data := x1Data, shape := x1Shape }
        let x2 := { data := x2Data, shape := x2Shape }
        let rec loop (i : Nat) (currentX1 currentX2 : Tensor) : Option (Tensor × Tensor) :=
          if i ≥ rsf.num_layers then some (currentX1, currentX2)
          else
            match rsf.layers[i]? with
            | some layer =>
              match RSFLayer.forwardStep layer currentX1 currentX2 with
              | some (nextX1, nextX2) => loop (i + 1) nextX1 nextX2
              | none => none
            | none => none
        match loop 0 x1 x2 with
        | some (y1, y2) =>
          let yData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin (batchSize * totalDim) =>
            let row := i.val / totalDim
            let col := i.val % totalDim
            if col < dim then
              y1.data[⟨row * dim + col, by decide⟩]
            else
              y2.data[⟨row * dim + (col - dim), by decide⟩]
          some { data := yData, shape := { dims := [batchSize, totalDim] } }
        | none => none
    | _ => none

def RSF.inversePass (rsf : RSF) (y : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  if ¬rsf.initialized then none
  else
    match y.shape.dims with
    | [batchSize, totalDim] =>
      if totalDim ≠ 2 * rsf.dim then none
      else
        let dim := rsf.dim
        let y1Shape : Shape := { dims := [batchSize, dim] }
        let y2Shape : Shape := { dims := [batchSize, dim] }
        let y1Data := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin (batchSize * dim) =>
          let row := i.val / dim
          let col := i.val % dim
          let srcIdx := row * totalDim + col
          y.data[⟨srcIdx, by decide⟩]
        let y2Data := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin (batchSize * dim) =>
          let row := i.val / dim
          let col := i.val % dim
          let srcIdx := row * totalDim + col + dim
          y.data[⟨srcIdx, by decide⟩]
        let y1 := { data := y1Data, shape := y1Shape }
        let y2 := { data := y2Data, shape := y2Shape }
        let rec loop (i : Int) (currentY1 currentY2 : Tensor) : Option (Tensor × Tensor) :=
          if i < 0 then some (currentY1, currentY2)
          else
            match rsf.layers[i.toNat]? with
            | some layer =>
              match RSFLayer.inverseStep layer currentY1 currentY2 with
              | some (prevX1, prevX2) => loop (i - 1) prevX1 prevX2
              | none => none
            | none => none
        let startIdx := rsf.num_layers - 1
        match loop startIdx.toInt y1 y2 with
        | some (x1, x2) =>
          let xData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin (batchSize * totalDim) =>
            let row := i.val / totalDim
            let col := i.val % totalDim
            if col < dim then
              x1.data[⟨row * dim + col, by decide⟩]
            else
              x2.data[⟨row * dim + (col - dim), by decide⟩]
          some { data := xData, shape := { dims := [batchSize, totalDim] } }
        | none => none
    | _ => none

def RSF.invertibleCheck (rsf : RSF) (x : Tensor) (tol : ℝ) : Option Bool :=
  if ¬rsf.initialized then none
  else
    match RSF.forwardPass rsf x with
    | some y =>
      match RSF.inversePass rsf y with
      | some x_rec => some (Tensor.isClose x x_rec tol tol)
      | none => none
    | none => none

def RSF.layerNorm (x : Tensor) (eps : ℝ) : Option Tensor :=
  if eps ≤ 0 then none
  else
    match x.shape.dims with
    | [batchSize, featureSize] =>
      if featureSize = 0 then some x
      else
        let newData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin x.data.size =>
          let b := i.val / featureSize
          let rowStart := b * featureSize
          let getVal (d : Nat) : ℝ :=
            if h : d < featureSize then
              let idx := rowStart + d
              x.data[⟨idx, by decide⟩]
            else 0
          let rowMean := ((List.range featureSize).map getVal).foldl (· + ·) 0 / (featureSize : ℝ)
          let rowVar := ((List.range featureSize).map fun d => 
            let v := getVal d
            let diff := v - rowMean
            diff * diff).foldl (· + ·) 0 / (featureSize : ℝ)
          let rowStd := Real.sqrt (rowVar + eps)
          let origVal := x.data[i]
          (origVal - rowMean) / rowStd
        some { x with data := newData }
    | _ => none

theorem RSFLayerConfig_default_valid : RSFLayerConfig.default.isValid := by
  unfold RSFLayerConfig.default RSFLayerConfig.isValid
  decide

theorem createWeightShape_valid (dim : Nat) (h : dim > 0) :
    (createWeightShape dim).isValid := by
  unfold createWeightShape Shape.isValid Shape.totalSize
  unfold List.foldl
  constructor
  · exact Nat.lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one (Nat.succ_pos dim)
  · exact Nat.mul_self_pos.mpr h

theorem createBiasShape_valid (dim : Nat) (h : dim > 0) :
    (createBiasShape dim).isValid := by
  unfold createBiasShape Shape.isValid Shape.totalSize
  unfold List.foldl
  constructor
  · exact Nat.lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one (Nat.succ_pos dim)
  · exact h

theorem createZeroTensor_isZero (s : Shape) :
    (createZeroTensor s).isZero := by
  unfold createZeroTensor Tensor.isZero
  intro i
  rw [Array.getElem_mkArray]
  exact rfl

theorem createZeroTensor_dataSizeMatchesShape (s : Shape) :
    (createZeroTensor s).dataSizeMatchesShape := by
  unfold createZeroTensor Tensor.dataSizeMatchesShape
  rw [Array.size_mkArray]

theorem createZeroTensor_hasCorrectShape (s : Shape) :
    (createZeroTensor s).shape = s := by
  unfold createZeroTensor
  rfl

theorem RSFLayer_create_preserves_dim (dim : Nat) (config : RSFLayerConfig) (h : dim > 0) :
    ∀ layer, RSFLayer.create dim config = Except.ok layer → layer.dim = dim := by
  intro layer hCreate
  unfold RSFLayer.create at hCreate
  cases hCreate with
  | error _ => contradiction
  | ok hLayer =>
    rw [hLayer]

theorem RSFLayer_create_initialized (dim : Nat) (config : RSFLayerConfig) (h : dim > 0) :
    ∀ layer, RSFLayer.create dim config = Except.ok layer → layer.initialized = true := by
  intro layer hCreate
  unfold RSFLayer.create at hCreate
  cases hCreate with
  | error _ => contradiction
  | ok hLayer =>
    rw [hLayer]

theorem RSFLayer_create_clipBounds (dim : Nat) (config : RSFLayerConfig) (h : dim > 0) :
    ∀ layer, RSFLayer.create dim config = Except.ok layer →
    layer.clip_min = config.clip_min ∧ layer.clip_max = config.clip_max := by
  intro layer hCreate
  unfold RSFLayer.create at hCreate
  cases hCreate with
  | error _ => contradiction
  | ok hLayer =>
    rw [hLayer]
    constructor
    · rfl
    · rfl

theorem RSFLayer_create_fails_on_zero_dim (config : RSFLayerConfig) :
    RSFLayer.create 0 config = Except.error RSFError.InvalidDimension := by
  unfold RSFLayer.create
  rfl

theorem RSFLayer_init_fails_on_zero_dim :
    RSFLayer.init 0 = Except.error RSFError.InvalidDimension := by
  unfold RSFLayer.init
  exact RSFLayer_create_fails_on_zero_dim RSFLayerConfig.default

theorem RSFLayer_deinit_clears_initialized (layer : RSFLayer) (h : layer.initialized = true) :
    (RSFLayer.deinit layer).initialized = false := by
  unfold RSFLayer.deinit
  rw [if_pos h]

theorem RSFLayer_deinit_idempotent (layer : RSFLayer) (h : layer.initialized = false) :
    RSFLayer.deinit layer = layer := by
  unfold RSFLayer.deinit
  rw [if_neg h]

theorem RSFLayer_zeroGradients_zeros_grads (layer : RSFLayer) (h : layer.initialized = true) :
    let zeroed := RSFLayer.zeroGradients layer
    zeroed.s_weight_grad.isZero ∧
    zeroed.t_weight_grad.isZero ∧
    zeroed.s_bias_grad.isZero ∧
    zeroed.t_bias_grad.isZero := by
  unfold RSFLayer.zeroGradients
  rw [if_pos h]
  constructor
  · exact createZeroTensor_isZero layer.s_weight_grad.shape
  constructor
  · exact createZeroTensor_isZero layer.t_weight_grad.shape
  constructor
  · exact createZeroTensor_isZero layer.s_bias_grad.shape
  · exact createZeroTensor_isZero layer.t_bias_grad.shape

theorem RSFLayer_zeroGradients_preserves_dim (layer : RSFLayer) :
    (RSFLayer.zeroGradients layer).dim = layer.dim := by
  unfold RSFLayer.zeroGradients
  cases layer.initialized
  · rfl
  · rfl

theorem RSFLayer_zeroGradients_preserves_initialized (layer : RSFLayer) :
    (RSFLayer.zeroGradients layer).initialized = layer.initialized := by
  unfold RSFLayer.zeroGradients
  cases layer.initialized
  · rfl

def createRandomTensor (shape : Shape) (low high : ℝ) (seed : Nat) : Tensor :=
  let size := shape.totalSize
  let range := high - low
  let data := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin size =>
    let idx := i.val
    let pseudoRandom := ((seed + idx * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648 : ℝ)
    let normalized := pseudoRandom / 2147483648
    low + range * normalized
  { data := data, shape := shape }

def Tensor.transpose2D (t : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  match t.shape.dims with
  | [rows, cols] =>
    let newShape : Shape := { dims := [cols, rows] }
    let newData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin (cols * rows) =>
      let newRow := i.val / rows
      let newCol := i.val % rows
      let oldIdx := newCol * cols + newRow
      t.data[⟨oldIdx, by decide⟩]
    some { data := newData, shape := newShape }
  | _ => none

def Tensor.matmul (a b : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  match a.shape.dims, b.shape.dims with
  | [m, k1], [k2, n] =>
    if k1 = k2 then
      let resultShape : Shape := { dims := [m, n] }
      let resultData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin (m * n) =>
        let row := i.val / n
        let col := i.val % n
        let sum := (List.range k1).foldl (fun acc j =>
          let aIdx := row * k1 + j
          let bIdx := j * n + col
          let aVal := a.data[⟨aIdx, by decide⟩]
          let bVal := b.data[⟨bIdx, by decide⟩]
          acc + aVal * bVal) 0
      some { data := resultData, shape := resultShape }
    else
      none
  | _, _ => none

  let newData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin t.data.size =>

    let tVal := t.data[i]
    let biasIdx : Fin bias.data.size := ⟨d, by
      have h : bias.data.size = dim := by

        cases bias.shape.dims

def RSFLayer.forwardStep (layer : RSFLayer) (x1 x2 : Tensor) : Option (Tensor × Tensor) :=
  if ¬layer.initialized then none
  else
    match x1.shape.dims, x2.shape.dims with
    | [batchSize, dim1], [batchSize2, dim2] =>
      if dim1 = layer.dim ∧ dim2 = layer.dim ∧ batchSize = batchSize2 then
        match x2.transpose2D with
        | some x2_t =>
          match layer.s_weight.matmul x2_t with
          | some s_x2_t =>
            match s_x2_t.transpose2D with
            | some s_x2 =>
              let s_x2_biased := s_x2.addBias layer.s_bias batchSize layer.dim
              let s_x2_clipped := s_x2_biased.clipInPlace layer.clip_min layer.clip_max
              let s_x2_exp := s_x2_clipped.expInPlace
              match x1.mulElementwise s_x2_exp with
              | some y1 =>
                match y1.transpose2D with
                | some y1_t =>
                  match layer.t_weight.matmul y1_t with
                  | some t_y1_t =>
                    match t_y1_t.transpose2D with
                    | some t_y1 =>
                      let t_y1_biased := t_y1.addBias layer.t_bias batchSize layer.dim
                      match x2.addElementwise t_y1_biased with
                      | some y2 => some (y1, y2)
                      | none => none
                    | none => none
                  | none => none
                | none => none
              | none => none
            | none => none
          | none => none
        | none => none
      else none
    | _, _ => none

def RSFLayer.inverseStep (layer : RSFLayer) (y1 y2 : Tensor) : Option (Tensor × Tensor) :=
  if ¬layer.initialized then none

    match y1.shape.dims, y2.shape.dims with
    | [batchSize, dim1], [batchSize2, dim2] =>

        match y1.transpose2D with
        | some y1_t =>

            match t_y1_t.transpose2D with
            | some t_y1 =>

              match y2.subElementwise t_y1_biased with
              | some x2 =>
                match x2.transpose2D with

                      let s_x2_biased := s_x2.addBias layer.s_bias batchSize layer.dim
                      let s_x2_clipped := s_x2_biased.clipInPlace layer.clip_min layer.clip_max
                      let s_x2_exp := s_x2_clipped.expInPlace
                      match y1.divElementwise s_x2_exp with
                      | some x1 => some (x1, x2)
                      | none => none
                    | none => none
                  | none => none
                | none => none
              | none => none
            | none => none

def RSF.forwardPass (rsf : RSF) (x : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  if ¬rsf.initialized then none
  else
    match x.shape.dims with
    | [batchSize, totalDim] =>
      if totalDim ≠ 2 * rsf.dim then none
      else
        let dim := rsf.dim
        let x1Shape : Shape := { dims := [batchSize, dim] }
        let x2Shape : Shape := { dims := [batchSize, dim] }
        let x1Data := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin (batchSize * dim) =>
          let row := i.val / dim
          let col := i.val % dim
          let srcIdx := row * totalDim + col
          x.data[⟨srcIdx, by decide⟩]
        let x2Data := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin (batchSize * dim) =>
          let row := i.val / dim
          let col := i.val % dim
          let srcIdx := row * totalDim + col + dim
          x.data[⟨srcIdx, by decide⟩]
        let x1 := { data := x1Data, shape := x1Shape }
        let x2 := { data := x2Data, shape := x2Shape }
        let rec loop (i : Nat) (currentX1 currentX2 : Tensor) : Option (Tensor × Tensor) :=
          if i ≥ rsf.num_layers then some (currentX1, currentX2)
          else
            match rsf.layers[i]? with
            | some layer =>
              match RSFLayer.forwardStep layer currentX1 currentX2 with
              | some (nextX1, nextX2) => loop (i + 1) nextX1 nextX2
              | none => none
            | none => none
        match loop 0 x1 x2 with
        | some (y1, y2) =>
          let yData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin (batchSize * totalDim) =>
            let row := i.val / totalDim
            let col := i.val % totalDim
            if col < dim then
              y1.data[⟨row * dim + col, by decide⟩]
            else
              y2.data[⟨row * dim + (col - dim), by decide⟩]
          some { data := yData, shape := { dims := [batchSize, totalDim] } }
        | none => none
    | _ => none

def RSF.inversePass (rsf : RSF) (y : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  if ¬rsf.initialized then none
  else
    match y.shape.dims with
    | [batchSize, totalDim] =>
      if totalDim ≠ 2 * rsf.dim then none
      else
        let dim := rsf.dim
        let y1Shape : Shape := { dims := [batchSize, dim] }
        let y2Shape : Shape := { dims := [batchSize, dim] }
        let y1Data := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin (batchSize * dim) =>
          let row := i.val / dim
          let col := i.val % dim
          let srcIdx := row * totalDim + col
          y.data[⟨srcIdx, by decide⟩]
        let y2Data := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin (batchSize * dim) =>
          let row := i.val / dim
          let col := i.val % dim
          let srcIdx := row * totalDim + col + dim
          y.data[⟨srcIdx, by decide⟩]
        let y1 := { data := y1Data, shape := y1Shape }
        let y2 := { data := y2Data, shape := y2Shape }
        let rec loop (i : Int) (currentY1 currentY2 : Tensor) : Option (Tensor × Tensor) :=
          if i < 0 then some (currentY1, currentY2)
          else
            match rsf.layers[i.toNat]? with
            | some layer =>
              match RSFLayer.inverseStep layer currentY1 currentY2 with
              | some (prevX1, prevX2) => loop (i - 1) prevX1 prevX2
              | none => none
            | none => none
        let startIdx := rsf.num_layers - 1
        match loop startIdx.toInt y1 y2 with
        | some (x1, x2) =>
          let xData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin (batchSize * totalDim) =>
            let row := i.val / totalDim
            let col := i.val % totalDim
            if col < dim then
              x1.data[⟨row * dim + col, by decide⟩]
            else
              x2.data[⟨row * dim + (col - dim), by decide⟩]
          some { data := xData, shape := { dims := [batchSize, totalDim] } }
        | none => none
    | _ => none

def RSF.invertibleCheck (rsf : RSF) (x : Tensor) (tol : ℝ) : Option Bool :=
  if ¬rsf.initialized then none
  else
    match RSF.forwardPass rsf x with
    | some y =>
      match RSF.inversePass rsf y with
      | some x_rec => some (Tensor.isClose x x_rec tol tol)
      | none => none
    | none => none

def RSF.layerNorm (x : Tensor) (eps : ℝ) : Option Tensor :=
  if eps ≤ 0 then none
  else
    match x.shape.dims with
    | [batchSize, featureSize] =>
      if featureSize = 0 then some x
      else
        let newData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin x.data.size =>
          let b := i.val / featureSize
          let rowStart := b * featureSize
          let getVal (d : Nat) : ℝ :=
            if h : d < featureSize then
              let idx := rowStart + d
              x.data[⟨idx, by decide⟩]
            else 0
          let rowMean := ((List.range featureSize).map getVal).foldl (· + ·) 0 / (featureSize : ℝ)
          let rowVar := ((List.range featureSize).map fun d => 
            let v := getVal d
            let diff := v - rowMean
            diff * diff).foldl (· + ·) 0 / (featureSize : ℝ)
          let rowStd := Real.sqrt (rowVar + eps)
          let origVal := x.data[i]
          (origVal - rowMean) / rowStd
        some { x with data := newData }
    | _ => none
